REQ-FLAT-CONFIG / Quality Standards (ESLint v9 flat config best practices): - Project flat config file: eslint.config.js - Exports an array of config objects using ESLint v9 flat config format via module.exports = [ ... ]. - Composes @eslint/js recommended config: js.configs.recommended as the first element. - Adds targeted overrides: - Node config files (files: ["*.config.js", "*.config.mjs", "jest.config.js"]) with commonjs sourceType and Node globals. - Special handling for tests/integration/cli-integration.test.ts with script sourceType and Node globals. - TypeScript files (files: ["**/*.ts", "**/*.tsx"]) with @typescript-eslint/parser and project-based parserOptions. - JavaScript/JSX files (files: ["**/*.js", "**/*.jsx"]) with ecmaVersion 2022 and module sourceType. - Test files (files: patterns for *.test.{js,ts,tsx} and __tests__) with Jest globals and relaxed complexity/size rules. - ignores: ["lib/**", "node_modules/**", "coverage/**", ".cursor/**", ".voder/**", "docs/**", "*.md"]. - Plugin loading is robust for dev and CI: tries ./src/index.js, falls back to ./lib/src/index.js, fails fast in CI if neither exists, warns locally otherwise. - user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md provides comprehensive ESLint 9 flat-config guidance: - Explains configuration file format, ESM vs CommonJS, and best practices (use eslint.config.js, array of objects, js.configs.recommended, ignores instead of .eslintignore, etc.). - Shows how to integrate this plugin: export default [js.configs.recommended, traceability.configs.recommended]. - Includes a full "Working Example" flat config for a TypeScript ESLint plugin project, closely matching this repo’s eslint.config.js. - README.md: - Provides a basic eslint.config.js example and a Quick Start that uses traceability.configs.recommended inside a flat config.

REQ-PROJECT-INTEGRATION (TypeScript, JavaScript, mixed projects): - This repository’s eslint.config.js shows real-world integration patterns: - JS/TS split via separate blocks for TS ("**/*.ts", "**/*.tsx") and JS ("**/*.js", "**/*.jsx"). - Node-specific block for config files with commonjs sourceType and Node globals. - Test-specific block for *.test.{js,ts,tsx} and __tests__ dirs with Jest globals. - Traceability plugin is conditionally attached to both TS and JS blocks: plugins: { ...(plugin.rules ? { traceability: plugin } : {}) }. - user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md: - Provides distinct sections for "JavaScript Only Project", "TypeScript Project", "Mixed JavaScript/TypeScript Projects", and "Monorepos / Workspaces", each with concrete eslint.config.js examples. - Each example shows how to use js.configs.recommended and @typescript-eslint/parser correctly. - "Quick Setup" step 4 and the examples show integrating traceability.configs.recommended into these patterns. - user-docs/examples.md: - Example 1: ESLint flat config with recommended preset. - Example 2: Using strict preset. - Example 4: npm script example for linting a specific directory with a flat config.

traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for story 002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG are implemented and validated. The plugin exposes recommended and strict configuration presets via src/index.ts, with dedicated tests confirming their structure and rule mappings. ESLint v9 flat config best practices are followed in the project’s own eslint.config.js and thoroughly documented in user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md. Individual rules provide configurable options (e.g., scope, exportPriority, branchTypes, storyDirectories, allowAbsolutePaths, requireStoryExtension) with JSON-schema-like meta.schema definitions and additionalProperties set to false to enforce configuration validation. Tests in tests/config/eslint-config-validation.test.ts, tests/config/require-story-annotation-config.test.ts, and tests/rules/require-branch-annotation.test.ts explicitly verify these schemas and invalid-option behavior, covering REQ-CONFIG-VALIDATION and rule options. Integration with JavaScript, TypeScript, and mixed projects is demonstrated both in this repository’s own flat config and in multiple documented examples. User-facing documentation (README.md, docs/config-presets.md, user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md, user-docs/api-reference.md, user-docs/examples.md, and user-docs/migration-guide.md) provides clear setup instructions, configuration examples, and troubleshooting guidance. Based on this concrete code, tests, and documentation, the story is fully satisfied.
